extensions.name: ask-user-question
extensions.description: Tabbed questionnaire tool (ask_user_question) for structured answers from the user.

extensions.name: background-tasks
extensions.description: Durable background shell jobs with output and task management.

extensions.name: chrome
extensions.description: Control Chrome through the DevTools Protocol with session authorization.

extensions.name: claude-marketplace
extensions.description: Add Claude Code plugin marketplaces and install their commands, skills, agents, hooks, and MCP servers into pi.

extensions.name: computer-use
extensions.description: Observe desktop windows and send keyboard and pointer input.

extensions.name: context-include
extensions.description: Expand @path.md lines in AGENTS.md context files into an extra system prompt section.

extensions.name: goal
extensions.description: Persistent goals, task trees, autonomous continuation, and completion audits.

extensions.name: hooks
extensions.description: Run Claude Code and Codex hooks (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, and more) from pi, with per-hook trust.

extensions.name: iterm2
extensions.description: iTerm2 integration: tab color follows the agent state, session badge, status bar user variables, attention requests, and /terminal-setup.

extensions.name: lens
extensions.description: Post-write formatters, linters, type checks, LSP diagnostics and a read-before-edit guard.

extensions.name: ollama
extensions.description: Discovers models from a local Ollama, registers the ollama provider, and manages models with /ollama.

extensions.name: permissions
extensions.description: Allow, ask, and deny rules for pi tool calls, loaded from Claude Code settings, Codex rules files, and pi's own rules, with /permissions to pick sources and scope.

extensions.name: rewind
extensions.description: Per-turn shadow git checkpoints and conversation restoration.

extensions.name: ssh
extensions.description: Reusable SSH profiles, shared connections, remote tools, and remote bash mode.

extensions.name: statusline
extensions.description: Configurable footer status line: builtin presets and themes, command scripts, Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex status lines, and the /statusline editor.

extensions.name: subagents
extensions.description: Delegate tasks to child pi agents (explore, build, advisor, custom) in the foreground, background, or in parallel.

extensions.name: todo
extensions.description: Phased todo plans with dependencies, per-subagent scopes, a widget above the editor, and /todos.

extensions.name: typesafe
extensions.description: Structured TypeSafe judgments with session controls and usage limits.

extensions.name: web-search
extensions.description: Search the web and read URLs with model-native and search providers.

extensions.name: compactor
extensions.description: Zero-LLM structured compaction summaries or LLM summaries with an active-work header, plus session recall and context budget tools.

extensions.name: observational-memory
extensions.description: Records observations and reflections during a session, uses them as the compaction summary, and adds a recall tool.

extensions.name: subscription-router
extensions.description: Several ChatGPT Codex and Anthropic subscription accounts as provider slots, quota-aware slot selection, 429 failover, and router/<profile> virtual models.
